_doc: SL D1 (2026-10-19): where each figure on a page comes from - written from the page's own code (which read fills that element), never guessed from a name. tools/render_figure_sources.py writes each page's entries into the page; utils.js whFigureSources makes the figure tappable. sel = the figure or the element its figures render into; whole = a label whose figures sit inside words; chrome = a number that is not data (why says what it is). period = the period, window or moment the figure belongs to (SL C2): 'Now: ...' for a count of what exists when the page read it, a named window with its kind, or 'All time' for a running total.
